description: Updates the state of an existing appointment (confirm / cancel / mark needs-reschedule). WRITE endpoint - has real-world effect on a real booking in Optofarm's live system.
caveat: Could NOT be tested live on 2026-08-31: after a real test booking was created via post_schedule.php (Dr. Baricz Anna, Tg. Mures Fortuna, 2026-09-01 09:00, patientName 'TEST TEST', phone 0700000000), no scheduleid for it could be obtained - it did not appear in get_schedule.php's listing nor via get_schedule_patient.php lookup by phone (several formats tried), even minutes after creation. See post_schedule.json notes: new bookings likely start in a pending/unconfirmed state not surfaced by the read endpoints, so there was no scheduleid available to call update_schedule.php with.
manual_cleanup_needed: The test booking above (Dr. Baricz Anna / Fortuna / 2026-09-01 09:00 / 'TEST TEST' / 0700000000 / test@test.com) was NOT cancelled and needs to be removed manually via the droot/evolvo admin panel.
open_question_for_droot_solutions: How does a third-party integration (e.g. a voice agent) retrieve the scheduleid of a booking it just created via post_schedule.php, given get_schedule.php/get_schedule_patient.php only appear to return confirmed ('Programat') bookings? Is there a delay before it becomes visible, a separate endpoint, or does staff confirmation happen first in the admin UI?
